MI-162 — fix the document-index POPULATION so the register can see the two
documents that outrank CLAUDE.md, and add the control that was missing.

`POPULATION_GLOBS` passed `docs/**/*.md` to `git ls-files` as a PATHSPEC, where
`**/` needs a literal intervening slash — so every `.md` directly inside `docs/`
was outside the population while the guard printed `population=971
registered=971` / `document-index: OK`. Population 971 -> 999.
